jobs.description:
Your Career at OMS Prüfservice Electrical safety inspections are at
the core of what we do at OMS Prüfservice . As an Electrician at our
Berlin location, you will provide excellent service to our customers
by ensuring the electrical safety and quality of inspections on site.
With your work, you help create a safe working environment while
becoming part of an innovative and future-oriented company. Your
Responsibilities Perform electrical safety inspections at customer
sites to ensure the safe operation of portable electrical equipment
Identify and record electrical hazards or defects using our digital
inspection software and smartphone (for example insulation resistance,
protective conductor resistance, or visible damage) Create digital
inspection reports and fault reports directly in the inspection
software. Reports are automatically provided to the customer Your
Profile You are a qualified electrician or have a comparable
electrical qualification You work carefully and pay attention to
detail You enjoy working with customers and have a friendly,
professional attitude English: C2 level (excellent written andspoken
English) German: B2 level (good German language skills) What We Offer
Salary based on your experience Holiday and Christmas bonus payments
Performance bonus of up to €100 per month Permanent employment
contract in a growing industry 30 days of annual leave Company pension
scheme and private accident insurance Financial support for private
cars (electric and combustion engine vehicles) and (e-)bikes Childcare
allowance Modern working environment and Kununu Top Company award
Membership with EGYM Wellpass, giving you access to more than 10,000
fitness studios and online fitness courses Various employee shopping
discounts Fixed working hours with no shift work Start your working
day directly from home Paid travel time Regional customer assignments
High-quality work clothing A motivated team with flat hierarchies
Opportunity to take part in paid language courses About OMS
Prüfservice Our goal is to be the quality leader in electrical safety
inspections. The foundation of our success is our strong team .
Working at OMS means thinking ahead and taking responsibility. By
delivering excellent results , we build trust with our customers every
day. Our values guide everything we do. They shape our daily work and
define our company culture. We have the courage to use our strengths
and are committed to creating a safer and more sustainable future .

AROUNDTOWN Commercial Properties (ATCP) is the asset management
platform for Aroundtown SA, the largest listed commercial real estate
company in Germany. ATCP acts as owner representative thus managing,
leasing and optimising the commercial real estate portfolio, which, in
addition to typical office properties, also includes industrial,
logistics and retail properties. In addition to our company
headquarters in Berlin, Aroundtown Commercial Properties holds branch
offices in Munich, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Hanover and Leipzig. Our
employees of various nationalities and their performance stand for the
success of our company. Your Tasks Transaction Execution & Management
Support the full deal lifecycle on acquisitions and disposals across
Germany and international markets, covering office, hotel,
residential, logistics, and development assets. Prepare financial
models, DCF analyses, and business plans for standing assets and
development projects; stress-test assumptions and evaluate investment
scenarios. Draft or assist with drafting and reviewing Letters of
Intent (LOIs), term sheets, and other transaction documents.
Coordinate and manage due diligence workstreams, including data room
management, adviser coordination, and cross-departmental
communication. Support signing and closing management, including CP
tracking and condition satisfaction. Investment Analysis &
Underwriting Screen, evaluate, and underwrite incoming acquisition
opportunities across target asset classes and geographies. Prepare
investment memoranda, board presentations, and transaction approval
documents that clearly communicate financial metrics, investment
thesis, and risk/return profile. Develop and maintain financial models
(Excel-based) for both stabilised assets and value-add / development
opportunities; produce Key Metric Summaries. Conduct in-depth
feasibility analyses for repositioning, conversion, and development
scenarios. Market Research & Deal Origination Conduct comprehensive
market research on target real estate sub-markets, including
supply/demand dynamics, rental trends, yield movements, and
competitive landscape. Build and maintain deal flow tracking tools and
acquisition pipeline databases (CRM). (Support) Deal-sourcing efforts
through broker engagement, market intelligence, and investment
screening. Participate in meetings with brokers, institutional
investors, JV partners, and other stakeholders. Your Profile Education
& Experience Degree in Business Administration, Real Estate
Management, Finance, Economics, or Engineering; MRICS / master's-level
qualification a plus. At least two years of professional experience in
real estate investment, private equity (real estate), M&A, asset
management, valuation, or brokerage. Track record of financial
modelling and investment analysis across European real estate markets;
experience with development projects is an advantage. Technical Skills
Advanced Excel skills, including dynamic financial models, DCF / IRR
analysis, and scenario modelling — proficiency is non-negotiable.
Strong PowerPoint skills; ability to produce clear, concise investment
presentations and board materials. Hands-on experience with AI tools
(e.g. large language models, AI-assisted research, prompt engineering)
and/or CRM / deal management platforms is a strong advantage.
Familiarity with data room platforms (e.g. Drooms, Intralinks,
Datasite) is a plus. Competencies & Personal Profile Strong
quantitative and analytical thinking — able to cut through
complexity and build conviction on investment cases. Self-starter with
high initiative, ownership mentality, and the ability to manage
multiple work streams simultaneously in a fast-paced deal environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills — ability to
present financial analysis and investment logic concisely to senior
stakeholders. Meticulous attention to detail, reliability, and a
strong sense of accountability. Collaborative team player with a
growth mindset and an appetite for continuous learning. Languages:
Excellent English (written and spoken) required; fluent German is a
strong plus and highly preferred for the German market. Your
Perspective Attractive remuneration package Significant scope for
professional development and accelerated career progression within a
large, institutionally led real estate platform. Deep
cross-asset-class exposure: office, hotel, residential/BTR, retail,
and development. Interesting, varied and broad range of tasks in one
of the largest real estate companies in Germany and Europe Very good
IT infrastructure with access to leading AI tools Good atmosphere ,
communication culture "on a first-name basis" and a pleasant working
atmosphere in an environment with flat hierarchies Individual training
for professional and personal development in our academy
Professionally equipped, in-house gym with trainers and classes
Comprehensive company health management and company pension scheme
Mobility and flexibility using pool and company cars for the execution
of tasks Exciting virtual programs for childcare with our partner
company Voiio Discounts at selected hotels worldwide with up to 30% on
overnight stays and special conditions on food and beverages
Additional days off on Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve Have we sparked
your interest? Then click on " Apply now " and Max Boikov will be
happy to receive your application documents, stating your earliest
possible starting date and your salary expectations. Aroundtown,
Personalabteilung, Wittestraße 30, Haus F, 13509 Berlin

About us CYBEX is a company that puts tomorrow’s people at the heart
of its brand. Always questioning the status quo and not afraid of
challenging the establishment, CYBEX has become not just a leader in
child safety but is seen as an innovative lifestyle and fashion brand
for parents. We offer car seats, baby carriers, kids furniture and
strollers enabling parents to keep their little ones safe in style.
After growing rapidly in the last few years, we look for ambitious
talent to contribute to CYBEX’s success story. Your seat to fill Own
the end-to-end integration architecture across Cybex, including
design, governance, and implementation of interfaces, ensuring
consistency and reusability across the landscape Lead the integration
requirements engineering process, covering both business and
non-functional requirements Establish and enforce Integration
Standards and Best Practices, ensuring all implementations follow
industry standards and Cybex governance frameworks, including API
management, security, and data exchange protocols Own the integration
documentation framework including templates, specifications, and
repository governance, ensuring consistency across internal teams and
external partners Drive collaboration with implementation partners and
vendors, providing architectural direction and oversight for
integrations leveraging SAP Integration Suite (CPI), EDI platforms,
3PL integrations, APIs, and other integration technologies Ensure the
solution delivery aligns with the project scope, quality, cost, and
timelines while proactively managing architectural risks,
dependencies, and trade-offs across integration initiatives Act as the
technical authority for integration architecture, supporting project
teams in design decisions, complex issue resolution, and ensuring
alignment with architectural standards Promote reusability and
standardization across integration components, including adapters,
connectors, and patterns, to reduce duplication and improve
maintainability across the IT landscape Drive continuous improvement
of the integration landscape like performance optimization,
observability, standardization of integration components and adoption
of new capabilities Your stroll to CYBEX Strong expertise in SAP
Integration Suite (CPI) and SAP integration scenarios (A2A and B2B)
Solid experience with EDI platforms and B2B integrations with external
partners Hands-on experience designing and implementing API-based
integrations (RESTful services) Good understanding of integration
protocols such as HTTP/S, AS2, SFTP, and SOAP Proven ability to
integrate SAP S/4HANA with external systems and third-party platforms
Experience in cross-system integration architecture and middleware
design Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, message and
event based integrations Ability to design scalable and robust
integration solutions across hybrid landscapes Fluent in English, both
verbally and written with German language skills being an added
advantage Here's what you can look forward to A future-proof job at an
innovative and dynamic company An inspiring work environment where you
can actively contribute and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom An
open and fair environment for all our employees that actively promotes
equality and diversity Competitive salary and benefits Opportunities
for continuing education to support your personal and professional
development How to contact us If you are interested in this
challenging position, we look forward to receiving your application.
Please submit your application materials through our application
portal. Thank you for your interest in joining the CYBEX/Goodbaby
team!

About us We're a 65-person EdTech scale-up operating across Europe, on
a mission to help educators bring learning and belonging for every
child. Our AV1 robot is deployed across 19 countries with 5,000+
units, supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and
continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present.
Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between
the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and
the essential sense of social belonging. The Opportunity — Marketing
Manager As a Marketing Manager, you’ll play a key role in bringing
our mission to life through the marketing campaigns: helping educators
bring learning and belonging to every child. You will be the decision
maker for our DACH and BENELUX campaigns. You will be responsible for:
Adapting and executing the global marketing strategy for audiences in
DACH and BENELUX. Driving marketing qualified leads from school
authorities and schools. Raising awareness of school non-attendance as
a growing challenge, positioning the AV1 robot as a trusted tool for
early intervention and school non-attendance, and engaging
decision-makers with compelling, evidence-based content. From crafting
case studies and coordinating national campaigns to enabling local
outreach and events, you will align marketing activity with Sales
goals and ensure every campaign is purposeful, measurable, and
relevant to the needs of our customers. What You’ll Do — Scope &
Responsibilities Marketing strategy & execution: Adapt and deliver the
DACH and BENELUX marketing strategy that aligns with the global
marketing strategy, local business objectives and the overall company
strategy. Contribute to the global marketing strategy from a DACH and
BENELUX perspective. Campaign management: Plan, execute, and manage
multi-channel marketing campaigns (including email marketing, content,
webinars, events/conferences and other tactics) to drive problem &
brand awareness and lead generation in the DACH and BENELUX markets.
Content localisation: Ensure that all marketing content and campaigns
are localised for the DACH and BENELUX audience while maintaining
brand consistency. Marketing Effectiveness: Oversee the marketing
budgets for your regions, ensuring all initiatives drive forward
marketing’s key performance indicators: Marketing Qualified Leads
(MQLs), Conversion Rate (from MQL to Customer) and Return on Marketing
Investment (ROMI). Performance analysis: Track, analyse, and report on
the success of marketing campaigns, using insights to optimise future
activities. What You Bring — Experience & Capabilities Strong
understanding of marketing principles, strategy, content creation, and
demand generation. Ideally from B2B tech or high-value education
products. Knowledge of the DACH and BENELUX markets – especially
Germany and The Netherlands – including customer behaviour, media
landscapes, and regional cultural nuances. Familiarity with marketing
automation tools, CRM platforms (e.g. HubSpot), Content Management
Systems (e.g. Webflow), email marketing tools and analytics software.
Proven ability to manage multiple complex campaigns simultaneously,
balancing high-level strategy with tactical delivery. Strong
communication and interpersonal skills (German and English business
fluency essential, Dutch desirable). Expert at analyzing performance
metrics to derive actionable insights and drive measurable business
impact. Autonomous and capable of taking initiative, while also being
an effective team player. Problem-solving skills with a creative
approach to overcoming challenges. A mature professional presence and
the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. Why You’ll Love
it Here Purposeful campaigns: Your work keeps thousands of children
connected, learning, and included every single day. You can see the
impact you have with every child’s story. Autonomous ownership and
trust: As the main Marketing person for the DACH and BENELUX, you will
be given freedom to plan and execute whatever you see fit, as long as
it aligns with our global strategy and pushes the needle further. Grow
your craft: Elevate your skills in a lean environment, with freedom to
propose what you assess to be best practices and build on your
strengths. No bureaucracy: We are all pulling in the same direction -
there’s no space for bureaucracy or politics. Whatever supports our
mission, is what we focus on. Generous paid annual leave: You get 27
days vacation + public holidays. Mobile phone and Internet
subscription JobAuto car leasing Access to digital mental health
support service including free therapy sessions Annual company
get-together: Once a year we all meet up for a few days of connection,
socialising, and some truly memorable shared experiences. Additional
details Location This position is based in Munich with a hybrid
working model. You will report to our Global Marketing Director (based
in London) and work closely with cross-functional teams in Munich,
Oslo, London and remote. How to Apply Please click Apply and upload
your CV and a short cover letter in English outlining your motivation.
If you’d like, you can also include a short video (in English ) as
part of your application – this is optional, but it gives us a
chance to see a bit more of who you are beyond your CV. Let your
personality and passion shine! So if you want to own a marketing
function for the DACH and BENELUX regions in a company where your
campaigns empower schools to embrace true inclusion - this is your
opportunity, and we’d love to hear from you. You may watch how AV1
transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115 You may
explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com We kindly
ask external recruitment agencies and consultants to refrain from
contacting us regarding this position.

About us THOST is one of the leading German companies in project
management. From our locations in Germany and abroad, we manage
complex projects in the fields of real estate, mobility, IT, plant
engineering, infrastructure and energy. With our broad expertise in
project management, we serve national and international industrial
clients as well as public and private investors. Projects are our
world! Deine Aufgaben KI2615 | Junior Business Development Manager
(m/f/d) Pforzheim, Warschau (POL), Legnica (POL) Search and contacting
prospective clients Scheduling and coordinating meetings Managing
follow-ups after meetings and events Maintaining and updating
Salesforce records Preparing presentations and sales materials
Preparing tailored client proposals, including creating offer numbers
Tasked tracking and documentation Project organization and
documentation Cost estimation Maintenance of databases (e.g. project
costs, project accounting) Handling customer-specific procurement and
billing systems Preparation of presentations, cost reports and status
reports Support in contract and claim management Your Profile
Completed technical, commercial or preferably academic education Sound
knowledge of MS Office (especially PowerPoint and MS Project) Initial
professional experience in an engineering consultancy or in industry
is desirable Strong teamwork and communication skills, flexibility and
commitment Mandatory language skills: Mandarin and English Willingness
to travel nationally and internationally, as well as willingness to
relocate nationally and internationally We offer Unlimited longterm
employment and career Participation in interesting, challenging and
future-shaping projects nationally and internationally Flexible
working hoursTargeted further development of your methodological
toolset and personal competencies Distinctive team atmosphere within
our family-owned company Holistic climate protection policy Contact
E-Mail: career@thost.com Homepage: https://thost.de/en/career You can
find detailed information on how we handle your personal data as part
of the application process in our privacy policy.

About us At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian
EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring
learning and belonging to every child. Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19
countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance,
belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be
physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it
bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both
educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.
We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong
financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague
to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth. The Opportunity

- Account (Sales) Manager (m/w/d) We are already quite established in
Germany. With 1,500+ units already deployed nationwide with almost no
churn across strategic customers, it’s a proven, trusted, and loved
solution - used by teachers who need a reliable way to include absent
students, welcomed by families who feel their child is still
"there,” and embraced by pupils who can see, speak, and belong
again. The references are real, and the impact is repeatable at scale.
Our next chapter is expanding our footprint in Baden-Württemberg - a
strategic, organic expansion that extends what already works. It
represents a massive and vital opportunity for our mission. We’re
bringing the same quality, reliability, and outcomes that defined
success elsewhere, and we’re looking for a sales professional to
play a pivotal role in driving growth across the region. As Account
Manager, you will set your strategic focus, open executive-level doors
across education and public authorities, and orchestrate
multi-stakeholder decisions. Your craft is relationships: You’ll
cultivate a high-trust network across all your stakeholders - engaging
in person to move complex decisions forward. You will lead with rigor,
listen with empathy, and with executive credibility, you’ll turn
early wins into lighthouse references, and lay the operating cadence
that keeps momentum compounding year after year. What You’ll Do
Define and drive your territory strategy: Build and execute the
go-to-market plan for your focus area within the region -
segmentation, territory mapping, prioritizing key accounts, and
setting milestones that turn strategic goals into tangible outcomes.
Build strategic executive relationships: Build trust with education
authorities, municipal leaders, and school executives - map decision
paths, align to policy and budget cycles, and secure multi-level
sponsorship. Win and expand strategic accounts: Lead full-cycle
acquisition and growth; align executive sponsors, budget owners, and
procurement; run multi-stakeholder close plans to signed agreements.
Lead with consultative, framework-led sales: Combine solution selling
with proven methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger)
to pressure-test value, control timelines, and move from business case
to signed terms. Collaborate for seamless delivery and growth: Partner
with Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure smooth
onboarding and implementation, capture outcomes, and turn success into
expansion and credible references. Create regional momentum: Build a
trusted partner network (associations, advocacy groups, integrators)
to accelerate adoption, and build visible presence by speaking at and
hosting conferences, roundtables, and policy forums to shape the
inclusion agenda. What You Bring New-business track record with
long-tail sales cycles (Germany): Solid B2B experience - creating and
closing multi-stakeholder deals, managing long cycles, and driving
consensus to close. Experience selling to the educational or public
sector will be a strong advantage. Executive relationship builder:
Ability to build credibility and earn trust from C-suite to school
leaders - advancing complex decisions through purposeful face-to-face
engagement and secure executive sponsorship. Strategic GTM & execution
discipline: Ability to build a targeted GTM strategy and turn it into
an operating rhythm - market segmentation, decision-maker mapping,
phased milestones, pipeline hygiene, and accurate forecasting
(HubSpot). Structured, consultative selling: Ability to run structured
discovery and build quantified ROI cases; experience with
methodologies such as MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN or Challenger is
beneficial. Language & location: Native-level German and professional
English; based anywhere within the Baden-Württemberg region. What We
Offer Proven platform: Expand within Baden-Württemberg with national
credibility, strong references, delivery expertise, and clear demand.
Territory ownership & autonomy: Own a key territory with significant
autonomy and decision-making responsibility. Growth & development:
Access to enablement, coaching, industry events, and opportunities to
help shape best practices as we grow in Germany. Tools &
cross-functional support: Work closely with Customer Success,
Marketing, and Product, with access to sales collateral, case studies,
and training. Scandinavian purpose-led culture: High standards,
meaningful work, and the freedom to do your best work. Highly rated
workplace: Engagement scores above benchmark, structured onboarding
with a buddy program, an annual company trip, and a collaborative
culture. Generous vacation: 27 days of annual leave plus public
holidays. Mobile & internet: Reimbursement for mobile phone and
internet subscriptions. JobAuto: Car leasing through salary sacrifice.
Annual company get-together: A yearly multi-day event focused on
connection, socializing, and memorable shared experiences.

Liebherr-Digital Development Center GmbH in Ulm develops digital
solutions for the entire Liebherr Group. Our passionate team from the
areas of software development, engineering and data science works
together on various projects from the whole Liebherr product world.
Our mission: creating outstanding digital experiences! Your
responsibilities Define and implement cloud infrastructure and
observability tooling – Be a passionate software developer Support
and development of complex and innovative shared development utilities
Create and maintain automation processes Implement cloud services –
Develop holistic software modules Support deployment – Care about
continuous integration and deployment processes Collaborate in
interdisciplinary teams – Being an enthusiastic agile team member
Ensure DevOps – You build it, you run it. Your qualifications
B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science and at least 3 years’ experience in
software development Confident use of agentic AI tools for workflow
automation, problem-solving, and software development At least 2
years’ experience with cloud technologies, cloud providers (Azure,
AWS, GCP), cloud tooling (Containers, Kubernetes, Grafana Cloud etc.)
and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) Proficiency in developing cloud
native frameworks like Terraform custom providers Experience in
software development with common programming languages like Java, C#
or Golang & experience with continuous integration Familiarity with
storage technologies and in development of distributed software
Excellent spoken and written communication skills in German & English
High degree of motivation & ability to collaborate in agile teams Our
offer A challenging and interesting range of activities awaits you at
Liebherr in an internationally successful Group. We offer you a secure
job with the social contributions of a modern organisation and pay a
performance-based salary. Reference 83306 Standort Liebherr-Digital
Development Center GmbH Konrad-Zuse-Straße 4 89081 Ulm Deutschland
Kontakt Liebherr-Digital Development Center GmbH
franziska.rolle@liebherr.com

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. About the Role We are seeking a
proactive and highly organized Administration Specialist (m/f/d) to
join our HQ office. In this role, you will be responsible for
coordinating a wide range of administrative, operational, and
organizational activities that contribute to the efficient running of
the office and support a positive employee and visitor experience. The
ideal candidate is detail-oriented, service-focused, and enjoys
managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. You will work
closely with internal stakeholders, external partners, and leadership
teams to ensure seamless administrative processes and excellent
operational support. Your Responsibilities Office Management &
Administration Manage the day-to-day administrative operations of the
HQ office Ensure the office environment is well-maintained, organized,
and fully operational Coordinate office supplies, equipment, and
vendor relationships Prepare and manage correspondence, letters, and
official documentation Maintain records, administrative files, and
internal databases Support document management and filing processes
Meeting & Event Coordination Organize and coordinate internal
meetings, workshops, training sessions, and company events Manage
meeting schedules, invitations, agendas, and logistics Prepare meeting
rooms, materials, and presentations as required Coordinate catering,
external service providers, and event-related vendors Support the
successful execution of employee engagement activities and corporate
events Travel & Logistics Management Coordinate domestic and
international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation,
transportation, and itineraries Support visitors and business guests
with travel and logistical arrangements Ensure travel documentation
and administrative requirements are completed on time Assist with
travel expense administration and reporting processes Administrative &
Operational Support Provide administrative support to management and
cross-functional teams Coordinate incoming and outgoing correspondence
and deliveries Support procurement and purchase order administration
Assist with invoice processing and vendor-related documentation
Contribute to the development and improvement of administrative
processes and procedures Stakeholder & Visitor Management Serve as a
point of contact for office-related inquiries Welcome and support
visitors, partners, and external stakeholders Coordinate
onboarding-related administrative activities for new employees when
required Foster a professional, welcoming, and service-oriented office
environment What You Bring Completed vocational training or degree in
Business Administration, Office Management, Hospitality Management, or
a related field Several years of experience in administration, office
management, executive support, or a similar role Excellent
organizational and coordination skills with strong attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high-quality
standards Strong communication and interpersonal skills Proactive,
reliable, and solution-oriented approach Proficiency in Microsoft
Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Experience
working with administrative and procurement processes is an advantage
Fluency in German and English What We Offer A diverse and impactful
role at our HQ office An international and collaborative working
environment Opportunities to contribute to office operations, employee
experience, and organizational effectiveness Professional development
and learning opportunities Flexible and modern workplace environment A
supportive team culture that values initiative, collaboration, and
continuous improvement Application Process Overview The position will
stay open until a successful candidate is chosen. Application Review:
Our team thoroughly reviews each application. Please make sure to
submit your CV in English. Initial Interview (30 minutes): Meet with
the hiring manager and HR team. Second Interview (60 minutes): Second
interview with a presentation on a relevant topic to the hiring
manager and the HR team. Offer: If successful, receive an offer to
join our team.

jobs.occupation: Lead SAP Finance Solution Architect (SAP FI/CO – S/4HANA) (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
jobs.description:

consultancies, helping global organisations unlock the full potential
of digital transformation through SAP S/4HANA, Cloud, and AI-driven
technologies. With over 700 SAP specialists across Europe and the US,
our client has built a reputation as a market-leading SAP S/4HANA
transformation partner — delivering complex enterprise programmes
for some of the world’s most recognised brands. Due to continued
growth and increasing demand across large-scale finance transformation
projects, they are now looking for a Lead SAP Finance & Controlling
Architect to join their high-performing SAP practice. Tasks As a Lead
SAP Consultant , you’ll play a key role in shaping enterprise-wide
finance transformation programmes — leading the design and delivery
of cutting-edge SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions for international
clients. You will: Lead global end-to-end SAP Finance & Controlling
implementations and transformation projects (S/4HANA environment)
Translate complex business needs into scalable, future-ready SAP
solutions Architect and optimise FI/CO processes within S/4HANA
environments Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and
C-level clients Drive integration across SAP modules (MM, SD, PP, and
SAC/BTP) and emerging technologies Lead workshops, shape roadmaps, and
influence business-critical decisions Mentor consultants and build
high-performing, collaborative project teams Contribute to innovation
culture through thought leadership and solution development Profile 5+
years SAP FI/CO Consultant experience Solid SAP Finance process &
customizing knowledge SAP S/4HANA experience preferred Consultancy
background preferred Fluent German & English We offer Highly
competitive salary package Remote/flexible working model Company car
Modern working environment - SAP AI, BTP, SAP Cloud World-class
training SAP Gold Partner - training & certifications Global offices
Certified Great Place to Work Additional contact details If you are
interested, please get in touch! My contact details are:
tommyw@energizerec.com +49 89 7453 913

jobs.occupation: Junior Project Leader (f-m-d) Engineering - Milwaukee® (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Job Description: Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in
cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our
focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial,
construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement,
repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes
MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® - recognized worldwide for their deep
heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality. The
company maintains a global manufacturing and product development
footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2
billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people
is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across
all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of
being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed
decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing
superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our
winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth. To
strengthen our team in Winnenden (Stuttgart area) as soon as possible,
we are looking for a Junior Project Leader (f-m-d) Engineering -
Milwaukee® Key Responsibilities: Lead and develop NPD projects in
EMEA in accordance with our development process on all technical
aspects for design and development Coordinate technical aspects in the
NPD Project for Professional Products EMEA or ROW driven Check
NPQ/PEAC/CTQs and coordinate results between Product Management,
Quality, Regulatory, Reliability and After Sales and prepare for EMEA
sign-off to provide a technical specification meeting to the customer
expectation Participate in the 2D/3D design reviews with Product
Management and Engineering Work closely with external partners and
vendors within the New Development Project Coordinate the Sample

IMPRS-ML offers high-level scientific training in a dynamic and international research environment with state-of-the-art facilities to doctoral researchers aiming for successful careers in science. Our comprehensive curriculum allows our students to tailor their learning to their interests, requiring them to earn 25-30 ECTS through various activities. Seminars, summer schools, retreats, elective courses, and participation in international conferences supplement their laboratory work.

JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
The strongest asset of our graduate program is our vivid and international research community. IMPRS-ML brings together two renowned Max Planck Institutes, the Max Planck Institute of Biochemistry (MPIB) and the Max Planck Institute for Biological Intelligence (MPI-BI), as well as two leading partner universities, the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) and the Technische Universität München (TUM), to deliver first-class training for the world’s most promising young scientists. Our graduate school comprises more than 250 PhD students from 40+ countries as well as 35+ distinguished and internationally recognised faculty members.
Applicants should hold an MSc (or equivalent degree) with a strong background in biological sciences, biochemistry, biophysics, biotechnology or a related discipline.
Outstanding applicants with a 4-years BSc hons (or equivalent degree) may be eligible to apply depending on the degree awarding country.

For more information, eligibility criteria and online application please visit our website:  https://imprs-ml.mpg.de/

We, the Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, are one of 85 institutes and research centers of the Max Planck Society (MPG) for the advancement of science. Our focus is on basic medical research. We currently employ around 270 people in science and administration, mainly at our location in Heidelberg. Another location for our institute is currently being established in Heilbronn. We are also part of the Health + Life Science Alliance Heidelberg Mannheim, an association of the region's leading life science research institutions.
